name: satsuma-lang

scripts.clean:all: rm -rf node_modules tooling/*/node_modules tooling/*/dist tooling/satsuma-cli/src/generated tooling/tree-sitter-satsuma/build tooling/tree-sitter-satsuma/tree-sitter-satsuma.wasm
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean:all && npm run install:all
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:md && npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: ruff check scripts/ tooling/tree-sitter-satsuma/scripts/ skills/ smoke-tests/ && ruff format --check scripts/ tooling/tree-sitter-satsuma/scripts/ skills/ smoke-tests/
scripts.format: prettier --write "**/*.{ts,mts,cts,js,mjs,cjs}" && ruff format scripts/ tooling/tree-sitter-satsuma/scripts/ skills/ smoke-tests/
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix tooling/satsuma-core run test:coverage && npm --prefix tooling/satsuma-viz-model run test:coverage && npm --prefix tooling/satsuma-viz-backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix tooling/satsuma-viz run test:coverage && npm --prefix tooling/satsuma-lsp run test:coverage && npm --prefix tooling/satsuma-cli run test:coverage

//devDependencies: commander is not used by anything at the root. It is declared here purely to
control hoisting: katex (a transitive dependency of markdownlint-cli2) pins
commander@^8.3.0, and npm hoisted that to the root node_modules while failing
to nest the ^15.0.0 satsuma-cli requires — `npm ls` reported the tree invalid
and the CLI silently loaded v8. A root declaration makes npm hoist v15 and
nest v8 under katex instead. Remove it once katex no longer pins commander@8.
See feature 42 R2; `npm ls commander` must report no 'invalid' entry.
